# Top Dispatch

> Top Dispatch places dedicated remote receptionists, dispatchers and back-office assistants from the Philippines with US home service businesses (HVAC, plumbing, electrical, locksmith, roofing, garage door, pest control, cleaning, landscaping, contractors and more). One trained person works your hours inside your software. Flat monthly fee, no setup fees, month to month, live in 48 to 72 hours.

## Key facts
- Founded: 2023
- Headquarters: Beverly Hills, CA 90212, USA
- Team location: Philippines
- Clients: 153+ active US businesses
- Staff experience: 2 to 5 years in appointment setting, dispatch, cold calling or back office
- Onboarding: 48 to 72 hours; clients interview their match first
- Pricing: flat monthly fee by hours and scope; no per-minute charges, no setup fees, 30 days' notice to cancel
- Coverage: client's US time zone; business hours, after hours, weekends or 24/7
- Phone: (833) 505-4136
- Email: support@topdispatchcrm.com

## Services
- [Virtual Receptionist](https://www.topdispatchusa.com/services/virtual-receptionist): Every call answered in your company's name by someone who knows your services, service area and prices.
- [Dispatch Coordination](https://www.topdispatchusa.com/services/dispatch): Jobs go to the right technician, the tech gets the details and the customer hears when to expect them.
- [After-Hours Answering](https://www.topdispatchusa.com/services/after-hours-answering): Evening, weekend and overnight calls answered by a person who follows your emergency rules.
- [Appointment Setting](https://www.topdispatchusa.com/services/appointment-setting): Bookings made, confirmed and reminded, and unsold estimates chased while they're still warm.
- [Cold Calling & Lead Gen](https://www.topdispatchusa.com/services/cold-calling): Outbound calls to prospects, past customers and lapsed maintenance plans that end with a visit booked.
- [Back Office Management](https://www.topdispatchusa.com/services/back-office-support): Invoicing, data entry, email, CRM upkeep and document prep handled while you're in the field.
- [Reporting & Analytics](https://www.topdispatchusa.com/services/reporting-analytics): Regular performance reports, job summaries and data so you always know how operations are running.
- [Customer Support](https://www.topdispatchusa.com/services/customer-support): Questions, complaints and after-job check-ins handled before they turn into bad reviews.

## Industries
- [HVAC answering service](https://www.topdispatchusa.com/industries/hvac-answering-service): Appointment setting, emergency dispatch, seasonal scheduling and technician routing for heating and cooling companies.
- [Plumbing answering service](https://www.topdispatchusa.com/industries/plumbing-answering-service): Emergency call triaging, booking, dispatch management and CRM updates for plumbing companies of all sizes.

- [Cleaning answering service](https://www.topdispatchusa.com/industries/cleaning-business-answering-service): Booking management, recurring schedule coordination and customer follow-ups for cleaning businesses.
- [Landscaping answering service](https://www.topdispatchusa.com/industries/landscaping-answering-service): Seasonal scheduling, crew dispatch, quote follow-ups and customer relationship management for lawn and garden businesses.
- [Construction & Contractors answering service](https://www.topdispatchusa.com/industries/contractor-answering-service): Project scheduling, contractor coordination, estimate follow-ups and client communication management.
- [Security answering service](https://www.topdispatchusa.com/industries/security-alarm-answering-service): Alarm monitoring support coordination, installation scheduling and customer account management.
- [Chimney answering service](https://www.topdispatchusa.com/industries/chimney-answering-service): Inspection scheduling, cleaning appointments and repair coordination for chimney service companies.
- [Air Duct answering service](https://www.topdispatchusa.com/industries/air-duct-cleaning-answering-service): Cleaning appointment coordination, technician dispatch and follow-up management for air duct service businesses.
- [Medical Spa answering service](https://www.topdispatchusa.com/industries/medical-spa-answering-service): Appointment booking, client intake coordination, follow-up scheduling and outreach for medical spa businesses.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: What does Top Dispatch do?
  A: Top Dispatch places dedicated remote receptionists and dispatchers from the Philippines with US home service businesses. Your receptionist answers calls in your company's name, books jobs, dispatches technicians, follows up on estimates and keeps your CRM up to date.
- Q: Do your secretaries speak fluent English?
  A: Yes. Every secretary passes English proficiency testing before placement and is trained to work with American customers. You interview your candidate before they start, so you can judge for yourself.
- Q: How quickly can I get started?
  A: Most clients are live within 48 to 72 hours of signing up. We match you with a secretary who has worked in your trade, brief them on your business and they start taking calls.
- Q: What industries do you specialize in?
  A: Home services: HVAC, plumbing, electrical, locksmith, roofing, garage door, pest control, cleaning, landscaping, construction, security, chimney, air duct and medical spa businesses.
- Q: Can I choose my own secretary?
  A: Yes. We put forward matched candidates and you interview them before committing. If you ever want a different person, we find a replacement.
- Q: What does the service include?
  A: Call answering, appointment setting, dispatch coordination, cold calling, back-office admin, reporting and customer support. You choose the mix, and most clients start with the phones.
- Q: What are the working hours?
  A: Your business hours, in your time zone. If you need early starts, evenings, weekends or overnight cover, we build the schedule around that.
- Q: Is there a minimum commitment?
  A: No long-term contract. Service runs month to month with no setup fees. You can scale up, scale down or cancel with 30 days' notice.
- Q: How do you ensure quality?
  A: Every secretary is vetted, English-tested and trained on your industry before placement. You get call summaries and reports, and a dedicated account manager reviews performance with you.
